entries.what: Walks to Flats High on Vinca for a regular school day. In Spanish for heritage speakers, the teacher hands out the oral family history interview project, due Nov 14, and Dulce picks Tía Gladys and the pupusa stand.
entries.outcome: Has a plan for the project but no questions written yet.

entries.what: Eats lunch in Ms. Tolentino's room B12 with Karina and Eli, then sits through third-period chemistry where the class gets back unit work.
entries.outcome: Notices she still has missing lab writeups to make up.

entries.what: Home at Marisol Gardens unit 114, eats dinner with her mom Yesenia and scrolls videos in her room by the laundry wall.
entries.outcome: Goes to bed around 11:30.

entries.what: School day: geometry through Spanish. At lunch in B12 she and Karina plan their Halloween costumes.
entries.outcome: Costume plans for Friday are set.

entries.what: After school she stays at the apartment to work on geometry homework, then texts Karina in the lab rats chat.
entries.outcome: Finishes geometry, skips the chem writeup for later.

entries.what: Calls Tía Gladys about setting a time to interview her for the Spanish project.
entries.outcome: Gladys offers a Sunday afternoon before the stand opens.

entries.what: Walks to school, takes a chemistry quiz review in third period with Ms. Tolentino, and eats lunch in B12.
entries.outcome: Told the lab writeup is due Friday.

entries.what: Takes a quiet afternoon at home and does a couple of problem sets, with the math parts going fast.
entries.outcome: Math done quickly; lab writeup still untouched.

entries.what: Eats dinner with Yesenia, who asks about school and reminds her of the phone bill.
entries.outcome: Dulce says school is fine.

entries.what: School day; Karina reminds her the chem lab writeup is due tomorrow. Dulce counts her paycheck money and the phone fund at lunch, still saving toward the used phone.
entries.outcome: Resolves to write the lab report that night.

entries.what: Helps at the family pupusa stand Thursday evening, folding to-go boxes beside Tía Gladys.
entries.outcome: Gets a quick chance to ask Gladys about the interview.

entries.what: Late at night she finally writes up the lab and only manages a three-sentence conclusion, pasting the half page to the assistant to ask if it is enough before it is due.
entries.outcome: Adds a bit more but still thin, goes to bed late.

entries.what: Turns in the thin lab writeup in third period; Ms. Tolentino posts updated grades and Dulce's chem grade drops to a C+ after the weak stoichiometry test and missing writeups.
entries.outcome: C+ officially replaces her B.

entries.what: Mentions the grade drop to the assistant, then changes the subject to ask for Halloween puns for her costume caption.
entries.outcome: Gets a few puns and moves on without dealing with it.

entries.what: Works her Friday 4-9 shift at Taquería Colima with candy on the counter for Halloween on Calle Ortega, trick-or-treaters filing in. Counts the drawer at close.
entries.outcome: Busy night; Rafael picks her up after close.

entries.what: Does Saturday laundry at the card-only laundry room in Marisol Gardens and finishes her costume leftovers.
entries.outcome: Laundry done.

entries.what: Hangs out with Karina in the afternoon and talks over the chem grade and how to catch up.
entries.outcome: Agree to start library sessions soon.

entries.what: Looks at the lab rats chat and watches TikTok edits at night, not posting any.
entries.outcome: Falls asleep late.

entries.what: Works her Sunday 10-4 shift at Taquería Colima, taking orders and eating a free quesadilla.
entries.outcome: Shift goes smoothly.

entries.what: After work she stops by the stand to ask Tía Gladys a few interview questions for the Spanish project and jots notes.
entries.outcome: Has rough notes for the project.

entries.what: Spends the evening at home thinking about the chem catch-up plan; plans to start study sessions Tuesday.
entries.outcome: Sets her alarm for school.
